name: MOO_PARTY_PURGE_LOGS
description:
After GDPR uptake, ESS purge job will be removing all the references of purged accounts and contacts from the transaction table of Opportunity, Lead, Sales Order, Activities and Notes.

We need to maintain a traceability to understand which all records in our tables had undergone an update during Account or Contact purge. This will help us to debug any issue that the customer reports, if they see that any contact/account that was associated to the consuming object has been wiped off.

To maintain traceability, this table is introduced, which will just record the details/primary key of the transaction record that has underwent the change

columns.name: PARTY_PURGE_LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique primary key identifier for the party purge log records.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the table name of the object getting updated during party purge process. eg: MOO_OPTY.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the object that's being updated during party purge. eg: OPTY_ID.

columns.name: PURGE_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the party type that is getting updated during purge. It can have two values ORA_ACCOUNTS, ORA_CONTACTS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
